request: 2011-W45 相比 2011-W44，GMV 变化了多少？给出两周的 GMV、差额（W45 减 W44）和变化率。
sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT week,
         sum(gmv_amount) AS gmv,
         count(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
         count(*) AS line_rows
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE week IN ('2011-W44', '2011-W45')
  GROUP BY week
)
SELECT round(max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W44' THEN gmv END), 2) AS gmv_2011_w44,
       round(max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W45' THEN gmv END), 2) AS gmv_2011_w45,
       round(max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W45' THEN gmv END) - max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W44' THEN gmv END), 2) AS gmv_change,
       round((max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W45' THEN gmv END) - max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W44' THEN gmv END)) / max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W44' THEN gmv END), 4) AS gmv_change_rate,
       max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W44' THEN orders END) AS orders_2011_w44,
       max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W45' THEN orders END) AS orders_2011_w45,
       max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W44' THEN line_rows END) AS line_rows_2011_w44,
       max(CASE WHEN week = '2011-W45' THEN line_rows END) AS line_rows_2011_w45
FROM w

columns.name: gmv_change
columns.meaning: GMV 差额 = W45 − W44（英镑，正数表示增加）

columns.name: line_rows_2011_w44
columns.meaning: 2011-W44 商品明细行数（笔，含销售与取消行）

columns.name: line_rows_2011_w45
columns.meaning: 2011-W45 商品明细行数（笔，含销售与取消行）

definition: 口径：按 ISO 周分组，GMV = sum(gmv_amount)（销售行计入、取消行计 0，含随后被取消的订单）；订单数 = count(DISTINCT order_id)（只数销售订单）；差额 = W45 GMV − W44 GMV；变化率 = 差额 / W44 GMV。时间范围仅 2011-W44 与 2011-W45 两周。
caveats: GMV 为下单口径，含之后被取消的订单；本周取消金额 W44 为 4,403.33 英镑、W45 为 7,583.32 英镑，W45 取消更多，故 GMV 增长并不等于净销售额同比增长。
数据中存在少数金额极大且下单后很快全额取消的订单，会抬高单周 GMV，解读增幅时需注意。
